promise.title: Accuracy over hype.
promise.body: AutoEco never invents financial figures. When data is missing, we say so. Estimates are labeled. Forecasts show assumptions.
diff.title: Not another expense tracker
diff.subtitle: A basic expense app records what you already paid for. AutoEco works out what it all means.
diff.traditional.title: A traditional expense tracker
diff.traditional.3: Leaves you to work out the total
diff.traditional.5: Tells you what happened, never what it will cost

diff.autoeco.2: Calculates true ownership cost per month
diff.autoeco.4: Forecasts your next 12 months of cost

diff.autoeco.6: Answers questions from your own data
diff.note: Every figure is calculated from data you recorded. Where something is an estimate, we label it.

trust.title: Your data stays yours
trust.subtitle: These are features you can use today, not promises.
trust.1.d: Download all your vehicles, fuel entries and expenses as CSV from Settings. Your data is not locked in.
trust.2.d: One click in Settings permanently deletes your account and scrubs your email address.
trust.3.d: We do not sell your data or run ads. Analytics events strip emails, names and vehicle identifiers.
trust.4.d: AutoEco is a financial tool. It will never tell you a car is safe or unsafe to drive.
cta.title: Ready to replace your guesses with numbers?
cta.body: Start free with one vehicle. Add your real fuel and expenses and AutoEco does the rest.
cta.secondary: Or try the calculator first â€” no account needed

ask.name: Ask Your Car
ask.examples_note: Every answer is computed from your own recorded expenses, fuel entries and distance. If AutoEco does not have enough data for a question, it tells you that instead of inventing a number.
